artworks.title: Symphytum officinale
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed close-up of a plant structure with elongated leaves branching out from a central stem. The color palette is monochrome, with various shades of gray. The plant is positioned horizontally, with the stem on the right side and the leaves fanning out downward. The background is clear, contrasting with the plant. A number "89" is faintly visible on the bottom right corner of the image.

artworks.title: Phacelia tanacetifolia
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows two large symmetrical objects resembling flower heads, positioned along the vertical axis. The color palette is monochromatic, featuring shades of gray. The top flower-like object is centered in the upper half of the image, and the bottom object is positioned in the lower half, connected by a central stem-like structure.

artworks.title: Scabiosa columbaria
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a large, intricate flower head at the center with numerous small petal-like structures and spiky projections surrounding it. The color palette is predominantly monochromatic, featuring shades of black, white, and gray. The flower is positioned centrally within the frame, with its stem extending downward, occupying the middle of the image. The background is solid and dark, emphasizing the flower's detailed texture and structure.

artworks.title: Acanthus mollis
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a tall plant with multiple large, closed flower buds along its central stem. The buds are bulbous and covered in spiky bracts. The color palette is monochromatic, with shades of gray providing a detailed view of the plant's texture. In the foreground, the plant is positioned centrally, with the stem vertically aligned and the flower buds emerging at regular intervals along the stem. There is a number "92" at the bottom right corner of the image.

artworks.title: Symphytum officianale
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a close-up view of a plant's buds and leaves in grayscale. The buds and leaves fan out from a central stem, positioned slightly off-center to the left in the frame.

artworks.title: Allium Ostronoskianum
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows unopened flower buds on a tall stem. The color scheme is monochromatic with shades of gray, black, and white. The buds are located at the top center of the image, with the stem extending downwards. The buds are tightly clustered at the base.

artworks.title: Aquilegia chrysantha
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a single large flower against a plain background. The color palette is monochromatic, with shades of grey, white, and black. The flower is centrally positioned, with its stem downwards and the petals and stamens extending upward and to the sides, dominating the composition in a vertical alignment.

artworks.title: Aconitum
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The sculpture in the image shows a stylized representation of a plant form, resembling a sprouting flower or leaf structure. It consists of layered, overlapping leaves curving elegantly from the base in an organic manner. The material appears smooth and solid, possibly stone, with a textured surface in some parts. The color is not clear due to the black-and-white photo, likely varying shades of gray. The sculpture is vertical, elongated, and detailed, capturing a sense of natural movement and growth.

artworks.title: Phacelia tanacetifolia
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image features two large, intricately detailed fern fronds in shades of black and grey. The fronds are positioned side by side, with one on the left side of the image and the other slightly overlapping on the right, both curling towards the top. The image is centered on a light, neutral background with a border around it, and a small number '97' is visible at the bottom right corner.

artworks.title: Phacelia tanacetifolia
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image displays a plant with two leaves and multiple small flowers with long stamens extending outwards. The color scheme is grayscale. The main stem is at the center of the image with the leaves curving outwards and the flower cluster positioned above it.

artworks.title: Salvia
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a tall, single stalk of a plant with several geometrically arranged buds and pointed leaves extending outwards. The color palette consists mostly of grayscale tones. Positioned in the center of the image, the stalk stands upright, with the topmost bud nearly reaching the upper edge of the frame, while the two leaves extend outwards towards the lower left and right corners.

artworks.title: Cirsium canum
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows three large thistle buds. The central bud at the top is fully bloomed with spiky petals, while the two smaller buds on the sides are closed. The color palette is grayscale with shades of black, white, and grey. The central thistle bud is at the top center, with closed buds on either side, and the stems converge towards the bottom of the image.

artworks.title: a Cirsium canum; b Phlomis umbrosa; c salvia
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image features three close-up views of plant stems and leaves arranged vertically on a page. The first view at the top shows a stem with multiple segments visible against a plain background. The middle image features a thick stem with textured leaves branching off towards the left. The bottom image displays curved plant stems with budding leaves. The image is in black and white, with varying shades of gray to highlight details and textures. The plant parts are centered horizontally on the page and vertically stacked in three separate segments.

artworks.title: Serratula nudicaulis
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: Two thistle-like plants are prominently featured in the image. The plants have pointed leaves and a feathery top, with stems emerging from the bottom left corner. One plant bends to the left, while the other leans to the right, creating an arc. The color palette is black, gray, and white, resulting in a monochromatic look. A vine spirals around the left stem, adding a delicate detail to the composition.

artworks.title: Abutilon
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows three large, dried seed pods on stems. The color palette is monochromatic, with shades of gray and black. The largest pod is centrally located and elevated slightly above the others, with the other two positioned to the left and right below it, angled towards each other.

artworks.title: Papaver
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows two black and white photographs of poppy seed pods. The upper photograph features a pod with crumpled and textured surface details visible at its top, while the lower photograph shows a pod with a smooth, rounded surface and a scalloped edge. The color palette is monochromatic, with shades of grey defining the shapes and shadows of the objects. Both pods are positioned horizontally in the image, with the upper pod oriented with its top to the left and the lower pod oriented with its top to the right.

artworks.title: Anemone blanda
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a flowering plant with a tulip-shaped bloom and textured leaves. The color palette is monochromatic in shades of gray. The flower and leaves are positioned centrally in the frame, with the bloom facing slightly forward and the leaves fanning out symmetrically. The background is a lighter gray, contrasting with the plant elements.

artworks.title: Lyonia calyculata
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a branch with bell-shaped flowers and elongated leaves rendered in grayscale. The branch extends diagonally from the bottom left to the top right of the image, with flowers clustered along it and leaves extending outwards. The number 106 is in the bottom right corner of the page.

artworks.title: a u. c Convolvulus sepium; b Campanula medium
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image features three black and white photographs of plant elements arranged vertically. In the top photograph, a long, slender object is positioned horizontally with its pointed end facing left. The central photograph displays a bulbous, rounded segment, possibly a partially opened flower, also facing left. The bottom photograph shows another elongated form with a textured surface, placed horizontally. The monochromatic palette emphasizes various shades and textures, ranging from dark grays to light whites. All elements are centrally aligned on the page in a parallel layout.

artworks.title: Vaccinium corymbosum
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a close-up of several large, unopened flower buds on a branch. The color palette is primarily grayscale, creating high contrast between the buds and the background. The branch extends diagonally from the bottom left towards the top right of the image, with four buds aligned horizontally along the top half, and a single open flower towards the bottom left side of the branch. The flowers and branch are sharply defined against a dark, blurred background.

artworks.title: a Andromeda floribunda; b Vaccinium corymbosum; c Acanthus mollis
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image features three black and white photographs of flowers displayed vertically. The top photograph shows an open flower viewed from the side, the middle shows a single large, tubular flower, and the bottom depicts multiple bud-like flowers on a stem. The color palette is grayscale, highlighting textures and forms against a dark background. The images are positioned one above the other, centered on the page, with each flower shot occupying its designated horizontal section.

artworks.title: Erica herbacea
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: A close-up image of a plant with a vertical stem covered with long, narrow leaves on the left side and several downward-facing, tubular flowers with dark tips on the right side. The image is in black and white. The stem rises from the bottom left corner of the frame, with the flowers extending to the right, occupying the center to the right edge of the image.

artworks.title: Campanula alliarüfolia
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image displays a close-up of a flower bud. Detailed textures cover its petals and leaves. The color palette is grayscale, showcasing its black and white composition. The flower bud is centrally positioned, with its base and leaves curving outwards at the bottom. The upper petals slightly open, showing their edges against a plain background. The image is enclosed within a border with the number '111' on the lower right corner.

artworks.title: Centaurea macrocephala
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image features a black and white photograph of a complex, detailed structure resembling a dried flower or seed pod on a textured stem. The object is positioned centrally in the frame, with the bulbous top dominating the upper part of the image and the stem extending downward through the middle.
